changes_vs_previous: Brent/WTI fell another ~3%, upgrading crude geopolitical-premium unwind into a multi-day trend; crude longs downgraded while refined-product scarcity remains distinct.

July PCE headline +0.2% MoM/+3.7% YoY was slightly hotter than consensus; core +0.2%/+3.3%. Post-release yields edged higher and equity futures softened, but synchronized exact ticks were unavailable.
IH reversed prior-day IM leadership: IH +1.18% close-to-close with OI +237 versus IM +0.34% and OI -11,152, signaling large-cap relative strength and small-cap leverage reduction.

ETF share-change estimates contradicted futures leverage: 510500/512100 showed strong estimated creations even as IM OI collapsed, consistent with cash dip-buying plus futures deleveraging rather than one-way small-cap liquidation.
HO/IO/MO ATM IV fell ~0.8-1.0 vol despite the cash rally; IO RR25 steepened to -2.84 vol and put OI rose 2,672, showing persistent left-tail hedging.
Nvidia event options imply ~5.4% move, below prior ~6.5% and 12-quarter average ~7.4%; event convexity and AI cross-sectional quality trades improved relative to naked beta.
